home.badge: Custom modules · dynamic dashboards · branded PDFs
home.heroSubtitle: Cubrel connects leads, deals, quotes, orders, and invoices in one workspace — with a module builder, drag-and-drop layouts, and dashboards that are actually yours to arrange.
home.note: No credit card required · Free for up to 3 users
home.highlightsLabel: Every module your team needs, connected out of the box

highlights.title: Custom modules
highlights.body: Model any process — projects, tickets, assets — with the module builder. Add fields, choose types, and go live without writing code.

highlights.title: Drag-and-drop layouts
highlights.body: Design list, record, related, and PDF views per module. Reorder fields, set required or read-only, and preview instantly.

highlights.title: Quotes, orders & invoices
highlights.body: Line items with automatic subtotals, discounts, and tax — and any module, not just the built-in three, can turn them on.

highlights.title: Branded PDF documents
highlights.body: Section-based templates for every module — header, line items, totals — rendered with your logo and colors.

highlights.title: Dashboards that are yours
highlights.body: Add, resize, and rearrange widgets. Metrics, charts, pipelines, and record lists — saved per person, automatically.

highlights.title: Advanced filters & saved views
highlights.body: Build multi-condition filters with AND/OR logic, then save and share them with your team.

home.howItWorksTitle: From a blank workspace to your first invoice

steps.title: Tell us about your company
steps.body: Add your logo, name, and contact details — they carry through to every quote, invoice, and PDF you send.

steps.title: Start with sample data or your own
steps.body: Seed a working CRM with demo leads, deals, and orders, or bring in a clean slate and add your own records.

steps.title: Invite your team
steps.body: Bring your team in by email, one at a time or in bulk. Everyone lands in a workspace that's already set up.

home.dashboardTitle: Arrange the dashboard your team actually needs
home.dashboardBody: Add metric tiles, revenue charts, pipelines, and record lists — resize and rearrange them, and Cubrel remembers the layout for every person, every time they log in.
dashboardPoints: Five widget types: metrics, time series, breakdowns, record lists, people
Drag-and-drop layout, saved per person automatically
Every widget filterable with the same condition builder as your list views
home.ctaTitle: Run your sales process without the busywork
home.ctaBody: Set up your modules, invite your team, and send your first quote — today.

features.title: One CRM. Shaped like your business.
features.subtitle: Stop bending your process to fit someone else's CRM. Cubrel is a set of connected modules you can extend, rearrange, and rebrand.

areas.title: Every module your business runs on, out of the box
areas.body: Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Quotes, Orders, Invoices, Products, and Cases ship ready to use — and when something doesn't fit, the module builder lets you add your own, with its own fields, layouts, and line items, without writing code.
areas.imageAlt: Cubrel's module manager showing all available modules

areas.title: Find anything, sorted and filtered your way
areas.body: Every list is sortable, searchable, and pageable out of the box. Build multi-condition filters with AND/OR logic, save them, and share them with your team — right down to a one-click "my records" view.
areas.imageAlt: Cubrel's Opportunities list view with sortable columns

areas.title: Record pages shaped exactly like your process
areas.body: Group fields into sections, reorder them, and mark any field required or read-only — all with drag-and-drop, no code. 16 field types cover text, currency, dates, addresses, and status pills with their own colors.
areas.imageAlt: A Deal record page showing General and Financial field sections

areas.title: See how every record connects, right on the page
areas.body: Link Deals to Accounts, Products to Orders, and any custom module to any other — one-to-many, many-to-many, or one-to-one. Related records show up as live panels, right where you're already working.
areas.imageAlt: A Deal record's Related tab showing linked Account and Products panels

areas.title: A dashboard your team actually checks every morning
areas.body: Add metric tiles, revenue charts, pipelines, and record lists. Resize and rearrange them, and Cubrel remembers the layout for every person, every time they log in.
areas.imageAlt: Cubrel dashboard with metric tiles and charts

pricing.title: Simple pricing that scales with your team
pricing.subtitle: Start free with up to 3 users. Upgrade as your pipeline, your team, and your paperwork grow.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.tagline: For teams running their full sales & billing cycle.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.tagline: For larger teams with dedicated onboarding needs.

faqs.a: Anyone who logs in to manage records — sales, support, or admin accounts. You're only billed for people who actually have an account.

faqs.q: Can I build my own modules?
faqs.a: Yes. The module builder lets you define new record types with custom fields, layouts, and line items, all without writing code.

faqs.q: Can any module have line items?
faqs.a: Yes — line items aren't locked to Quotes, Orders, and Invoices. Any module, including ones you build yourself, can enable them and choose which catalog they pull pricing from.
Business customers can deploy Cubrel on their own infrastructure with the same feature set as the hosted plan.
